name: resource-balance
title: Resource Balance
author: funtik13
description: A floating panel that shows produced, consumed and balance per minute for the items and fluids you pick — per planet or summed over all planets and platforms. Several lists with export / import, output targets, a watcher with a log and chart marks, stock in logistic networks and storage tanks. Diagnostics for long chains: which machines stand still and why over the last 30 minutes, the byproduct that clogs a line, a root cause tree and a factory-wide idle view — and it tells a full storage from a real deficit. Trend charts, a large chart and comparison of up to 4 resources. Made for overhaul mods like Pyanodon's.
